book.name: 2 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIHNINGNAH

content: Macawtaco dopaw vesaw sahlo, ma biakangnah sahlo heh a hnuipaw kaa cang cawtah pungsaw cang seh, thlawpaw cang seh, a papia a palui sahpaw maikaw taikhei a pathaisah he peh seh. Khazing cawh kaa cizaw cawtah a pathai hmuisuipaw cang a zong he peh.
Naa thinglung chung letah hminghmaw ma pachia pah my lo. Kaaning cawh aho khatah hmai suanah tua bang bei peh, ahohmai rawhrang bang bei peh, cawngsaw dungkhei bang bei peh.

Ma heh naaning sua phosah du tah ka reipaw cang be. Ka rei ciapaw hrakhei kaa lungthing chung letah hminghmaw hnui he ceh ka, naaning khatah kaa hring hrui he peh, a cang ly leh hming kheh tah kaa thi hrui he peh.
Naaning letah zingngangnah alaipui hnui neh ka, ka ca palaikhui ngetei he. Thawzaang naa pa peh ngetei. Ka ruhanah vytei chung taitah ka lawngnah heh reitepaw cang be.
Masidonia raang kaa phah tihtah a hia khy thly thly bei peh. Canghrasala kawkih letah hanah ung ka, a lailang letah a dynah ung ka, thinglung chunglang letah cinah a ung.
Canghrasala a hnabei a dongpaw lunghnaw a pangang teipaw Khazing taco, kaaning hnawpangang pawtah Tita khah va taw ka,

Tita a va tlung caw long tah cang lytah ama a hnaw naa pangangnah thongtah zong a cang. Ama taco naa pa vangnah kong, naa ngechianah le kaa cawtah kongpacangnah alaipui naa hnuipaw kong khah ma ching ka, ka lawngnah cawh a sang vy tima.

Ka cakua tah naa nge a ca chiasah zong he tah ka ciapaw khah a ngepachih bei neh. A hmasaw taco ka ngepachih, zemaw tah pawco ma ca takhei naa nge a ca chiasah caw he tah a cang, canghrasala, naa ngechianah cawh cai cuitei caw long tah a cang.

Atoheh cawh ka lung a lawng, ma cawh naa nge ka ca chiasah caw he tah cang lytah, naa ngechianah takhei a ca ngepachihsah nápaw he cawtah a cang hri. Khazing tei a tingpaw hrakhei naa nge a ca chia sahpaw he cang ka, macawtaco kaaning tah hanah zehmai ca pei bei he peh.

Ma Khazing a dupaw ngechianah taco angepachihnah chuakhui ka, ma taco pachahnah khah ca phah khui he ka, ma kong leco naa nge a ca chiapaw he cang be, canghrasala khazaw phung tei ngechianah taco thihnah a chuakhui.

Ma Khazing dupaw ngechianah tahei naa chung letah zemaw a chuasah takhah ming tua o. Ma takhei a ca hmuisuisah he. Naa sua lynah kong palang khah a ngete bei ceh. Naa thing ca aesah he ka, a ca pahlysah he. Kama hmuh khah du ngetei he ceh ka, ka zawng naa pa rawh ngetei. A hmangpaw hming tua pawtah a mai pacia tah ung he ceh ka, hmingchahly a tuapaw dangtah pawtah a mai pacia tah naa ung. Ma hming sahlo vytei lekhei suanah naa hnui lypaw khah naa langsah he ceh.

Macawtaco naaning khatah ca ka ca kua thlang hmai he tah hmingsua a tuapaw a cang ly leh a cung letah hmingsua tua a cangpaw cawngsaw kong khah cang lytah zetlua tamaw kaa zawng naa ma rawh takhah naaning tei hrahring tah Khazing hme letah naa hmuh khy thlang a.

Ma vytei tahei thawzaang a ma peh. Ma hlui co kaa thaw a tlungcainah cawh Tita zetlua tamaw a lung a lawng takhah kaa hmuhpaw heh cang ka, ma cawh naaning vytei tah a thlawpaw khah naa patha pah cawtah a cang.

Naaning naa kong letah ama khaco a pachaw neh ka, ka hme pa pachia bei he ceh. Canghrasala zezongpui khah hmuisui teitah ka ca chingpaw he hratah naa kong letei Tita khatah ka pachawpaw he peh cawh a hmuisuipaw a cang hrah.
Ama khah ci hmotah le a cathing hmotah cyhlang he ceh katei, naa zongmingtei tah a rei naa ngepaw khah a rawh ning taco, naaning a ca donah he cawh a thuh vy lo leimei.
Naaning cawh ka ca paichai khy he tah ka hni cawtah ka lung a lawng.
